profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Technical Summary
Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, Android Studio, Eclipse, C++, C#, Java, Python, Android NDK, Docker, ADO.NET, .Net, .Net Core, MSTest, AWS, moq, MVC framework, SQL, TSQL, SQL Server Management Studio, MySQL, IIS Manager, TypeScript, Angular, Java, Javascript, JSon, JQuery, HTML 5, CSS, REST Services, OpenAPI (Swagger), OAuth 2.0, OOP, DOP, CMAKE, Jira, TeamCity, Blender . 

Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere, Maya, Blender, Zbrush

Professional Experience
Sr. Software Engineer:
2015 - 2020
Tibco Scribe

Create middleware software that would allow data integration between multiple web services.

Some of the third-party vendors I worked with during the past 5 years include: Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Autodesk, Possible Now and Microsoft (Azure).

During this time, I also worked with our partners on specialized integrations that would use our software as a major part of their data layer.

Worked with our product managers and QA to create project stories based on use cases provided by the customer or third-party partners.

Periodically worked with our support team to investigate issues that would result in instructions for a workaround or a hotfix to be delivered to the customer and also be considered to be provided to all other customers as a patch or to be included on the next product release.

Created unit tests to verify and aid in the addition of new product features during the development process. These are classified and organized as Endpoint Acceptance Tests, Development Tests and Continuous Integrations Tests.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
I played a pivotal role in transforming a legacy document management system at PrismHR, enhancing its efficiency and functionality.  

• Modernized and rewrote search capabilities by integrating AI technologies, improving user interaction and data retrieval.  
• Overcame significant challenges related to external endpoints, ensuring seamless access to millions of records.  
• Developed skills in AI implementation and legacy system optimization, contributing to overall project success.
• Integrated AI into development pipeline to increase our  productivity and output speed.
• I am an active contributor in our efforts to integrate AI functionality.

positions.title: Back end / Front end Developer
positions.description:
Third Party Back and Front end Integration using C#, dot net, MVC, Java script, jQuery and Ajax.

Some of the third party vendors I worked with during my time at NH Cash include: Lexis Nexus, Strategic Merchant Solutions (Payment Processor), ThreatMatrix (Fraud Prevention) and Twilio (Text Messaging and Voice).

Worked as part of a development team on the creation of a loan origination and management system that is also able to support multiple lines of business using C#, MVC Framework, Entity Framework, Dot Net, IIS, T-SQL, CSS, HTML, java script and JQuery.

Created multiple class libraries that added new functionalities from data generation and basic business logic to other more advanced features like fraud prevention using C#, Entity Framework, Restful Web Services, Soap Web Services, SFTP and T-SQL.

Created a Periodic Statement generation system that collects, generates and output data. This system is also responsible for the delivery of such statements in the form of pdf files using C#, Entity Framework, ITextsharp, Windows Services and T-SQL.

During my time at NH Cash I earned a promotion from Junior Developer to Developer 1.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Web Services · JavaScript

positions.title: Game Developer / Concept Artist / Game Asset Creation / Web Designer / Frontend / Backend / Owner
positions.description:
Game Framework Modification and Implementation for Android.

Created the Game A.I. Utilizing Java.

Graphics Engine Development Using OpenGL ES and Java.

Game Engine Optimization and debugging.

Game Asset Creation Including Sprite Creation for Animation, Concept Art, Character Design.

Website Development Using Flash, PHP, CSS, JavaScript.
positions.insights: Skills: Blender · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Python (Programming Language) · Autodesk Maya · CMake · Unity

positions.title: Web Designer-Developer / Graphic Effects Artist / Animation
positions.description:
Creating HTML, CSS and Flash, Documents for website deployment.

Created Multimedia delivery system for website.

Creation of Logos and animations for TV and website.

Work with clients and project leader to achieve a final product that would satisfy the client needs.

Responsible for managing the entire process from basic design to deployment and meeting deadlines.

Develop deliverables ranging from wireframes, sitemaps, usability tests, reviews, and complete site creation and redesigns.

Design and develop website Using HTML5, CSS, PHP and flash.
